verdict.rationale: Stripe Agentic Commerce is payments/commerce infrastructure (APIs, MCP server, Link CLI, ACP/MPP protocols) that external AI agents (e.g., ChatGPT) plug into to transact on Stripe's behalf — it is not itself a consumer-facing product with a built-in AI assistant that a user delegates tasks to inside the product. The 'delegate to a built-in assistant' axis is a category mismatch for an agent-facing commerce infrastructure/API platform.
